name: Trakt Core
description: Shared Trakt default username and Client ID for the trakt_* widgets. Public profiles still need a Client ID. Creating an API app currently requires Trakt VIP.

settings.name: client_id
settings.label: Trakt Client ID
settings.help: Required. Trakt currently lets only VIP members create API apps (trakt.tv/oauth/applications). A public profile is not enough. Redirect urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob is fine — only the Client ID is used.

settings.name: username
settings.label: Default Trakt username
settings.help: Used when a widget cell leaves username blank. A profile URL also works. The profile must be public.
